title: Document
description: A piece of evidence that supports one or more policies, such as a flood risk assessment or viability study: the planning.data.gov.uk document record extended with proposed evidence fields. Not to be confused with a development plan document, which makes up the plan itself.

document-types.description: The types of evidence document this record refers to.

document-role.description: The role the document plays, distinguishing evidence from other documents in the dataset.

dataset.description: A reference to evidence held as data, such as a dashboard or table, rather than as a static document.

development-policies.description: References to the policies this document supports.

consultancy.description: A reference to the consultancy commissioned to produce the document.

requirements.description: References to the requirements this document addresses, matching the reference of each requirement.

commenced-date.description: When work on the document began.

finalised-date.description: When the document was signed off or completed.

superseded.description: A reference to the previous version of this record that this document supersedes.
